versions.content: Initialization of not-available ImplementationDataType- Element If a given ImplementationDataTypeElement is not available in the con- text of the definition of an initial value then a dummy initial value shall be defined anyway for the element in order to not break [constr_1272]. The provided ValueSpecification shall be considered as don't care.
